en.headline: September home sale registrations rise 18.5 percent
en.dek: The Land Registry logged 4,761 residential agreements worth HK$46.8 billion, still 15.6 percent below a year earlier.
body: Residential sale registrations picked up in September from August, but remained below the same month last year, the Land Registry said on Monday.

The registry logged 4,761 residential sale-and-purchase agreements submitted for registration in September, up 18.5 per cent on the month and down 15.6 per cent on the year. Their total consideration was HK$46.8 billion, up 29.3 per cent from August and down 0.9 per cent from a year earlier.

Across all building types, 6,438 sale agreements were lodged, up 11.6 per cent on the month and down 6.3 per cent on the year. Total consideration was HK$53.5 billion, up 20.1 per cent from August and little changed from September 2025. The figures record documents lodged for registration, not deals agreed in the month.

zh.headline: 9月住宅註冊買賣按月升18.5%
zh.dek: 土地註冊處公布，9月送交註冊的住宅買賣合約4761份，總值468億元，按年仍跌15.6%。
body: 土地註冊處星期一公布，9月住宅樓宇買賣註冊較8月回升，但仍低於去年同月。
9月送交註冊的住宅樓宇買賣合約有4761份，按月上升18.5%，按年下跌15.6%。合約總值468億元，按月上升29.3%，按年下跌0.9%。
所有種類樓宇買賣合約共6438份，按月上升11.6%，按年下跌6.3%；合約總值535億元，按月上升20.1%，按年變動不大。數字反映當月送交註冊的文件，不是當月新達成的成交。
